audit_log_actor_consistent.name: audit_log_actor_consistent
audit_log_actor_consistent.value:
("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'USER' and "audit_log"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_log"."actor_api_key_id" is null)
        or ("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'API_KEY' and "audit_log"."actor_api_key_id" is not null and "audit_log"."actor_user_id" is null)
        or ("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'SYSTEM' and "audit_log"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_log"."actor_api_key_id" is null)

audit_log_outcome_has_authorisation.name: audit_log_outcome_has_authorisation
audit_log_outcome_has_authorisation.value: "audit_log"."outcome" is null or "audit_log"."auth_method" is not null

case_analysis_events_document_only_compl.name: case_analysis_events_document_only_complete
case_analysis_events_document_only_compl.value: ("case_analysis_events"."document" is not null) = ("case_analysis_events"."status" = 'COMPLETE') and ("case_analysis_events"."wording" is not null) = ("case_analysis_events"."status" = 'COMPLETE')

case_analysis_events_error_only_failed.name: case_analysis_events_error_only_failed
case_analysis_events_error_only_failed.value: ("case_analysis_events"."error_code" is not null) = ("case_analysis_events"."status" = 'FAILED') and ("case_analysis_events"."error_message" is not null) = ("case_analysis_events"."status" = 'FAILED')

entities_named_kinds_external_identifier.name: entities_named_kinds_external_identifier_only
entities_named_kinds_external_identifier.value: "entities"."identifier" is null or "entities"."kind" not in ('PERSON', 'ORGANIZATION') or "entities"."identifier" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*:[^ ]+$'

entity_merges_merged_by_consistent.name: entity_merges_merged_by_consistent
entity_merges_merged_by_consistent.value:
("entity_merges"."merged_by_kind" = 'USER' and "entity_merges"."merged_by_user_id" is not null and "entity_merges"."merged_by_rule" is null)
        or ("entity_merges"."merged_by_kind" = 'RULE' and "entity_merges"."merged_by_rule" is not null and "entity_merges"."merged_by_user_id" is null)

entity_merges_revert_consistent.name: entity_merges_revert_consistent
entity_merges_revert_consistent.value:
("entity_merges"."reverted_at" is null and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_kind" is null and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_user_id" is null
          and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_rule" is null and "entity_merges"."revert_reason" is null)
        or ("entity_merges"."reverted_at" is not null and length(btrim(coalesce("entity_merges"."revert_reason", ''))) > 0 and (
          ("entity_merges"."reverted_by_kind" = 'USER' and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_user_id" is not null and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_rule" is null)
          or ("entity_merges"."reverted_by_kind" = 'RULE' and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_rule" is not null and "entity_merges"."reverted_by_user_id" is null)))

jobs_finished_after_started.name: jobs_finished_after_started
jobs_finished_after_started.value: "jobs"."finished_at" is null or "jobs"."started_at" is null or "jobs"."finished_at" >= "jobs"."started_at"

report_pdfs_file_only_ready.name: report_pdfs_file_only_ready
report_pdfs_file_only_ready.value: ("report_pdfs"."content_hash" is not null) = ("report_pdfs"."status" = 'READY') and ("report_pdfs"."byte_length" is not null) = ("report_pdfs"."status" = 'READY')

report_pdfs_error_only_failed.name: report_pdfs_error_only_failed
report_pdfs_error_only_failed.value: ("report_pdfs"."error_code" is not null) = ("report_pdfs"."status" = 'FAILED') and ("report_pdfs"."error_message" is not null) = ("report_pdfs"."status" = 'FAILED')

report_pdfs_finished_after_started.name: report_pdfs_finished_after_started
report_pdfs_finished_after_started.value: "report_pdfs"."finished_at" is null or "report_pdfs"."started_at" is null or "report_pdfs"."finished_at" >= "report_pdfs"."started_at"

reports_finished_after_started.name: reports_finished_after_started
reports_finished_after_started.value: "reports"."finished_at" is null or "reports"."started_at" is null or "reports"."finished_at" >= "reports"."started_at"

runs_finished_after_started.name: runs_finished_after_started
runs_finished_after_started.value: "runs"."finished_at" is null or "runs"."started_at" is null or "runs"."finished_at" >= "runs"."started_at"

runs_person_target_recorded.name: runs_person_target_recorded
runs_person_target_recorded.value: "runs"."person_bearing" or "runs"."requested_target_type" is null or "runs"."requested_target_type"::text not in ('TOPIC')

tenants_report_handling_marking_format.name: tenants_report_handling_marking_format
tenants_report_handling_marking_format.value: "tenants"."report_handling_marking" is null or ("tenants"."report_handling_marking" = btrim("tenants"."report_handling_marking") and length("tenants"."report_handling_marking") between 1 and 80 and "tenants"."report_handling_marking" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

usage_events_attempt_with_work.name: usage_events_attempt_with_work
usage_events_attempt_with_work.value: "usage_events"."attempt" is null or "usage_events"."job_id" is not null or "usage_events"."report_id" is not null

usage_events_model_calls_with_report.name: usage_events_model_calls_with_report
usage_events_model_calls_with_report.value: "usage_events"."model_calls" is null or ("usage_events"."report_id" is not null and jsonb_typeof("usage_events"."model_calls") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("usage_events"."model_calls") >= 1)
